hypothesis: Past settled positive funding reflects crowded longs and adds positive conditional information for next-seven-day short price-cost opportunities after fixed own-price and asset controls
scope: Single funding-channel conditional attribution; feature and joint neural use already exist, no new-feature/old-selector-impossibility claim
maturity: decision >= split_start and label_end < split_end; purge cross-year/half-year endpoints; no overlapping weekly labels within a role
publication_proxy: Only settled events in [D-8days,D-1day); calc_time strictly <D-24h, no historical receive/publication clock certification
funding_feature: One per-asset raw settled funding-rate sum; nominal168h and gaps checked from past events only; uniform fraction/percent conversion cancels under fit-only standardization
settlement_cadence_QA: Actual calc_time timestamps retained and compared strictly for availability; allow <=60sec observed settlement jitter around declared nominal consecutive interval, but missing whole event/nominal168h failure remains unavailable. No rounding or boundary shift
baseline: ret1/7/21 divided by sqrt(h)*past30day log-return samplevol, log(pastvol), four symbol indicators; intercept
augmented: Identical baseline + one funding feature; both arms use the same causal price+funding readiness mask
risk_normalized_target: BASE27 paid entry/exit unit-short close-price proxy divided by sqrt(7)*past30day vol
cost_profile: BASE27: fee5.5bp + halfspread4bp + slippage4bp per fill; fee on slipped fill, no second debit. Closed-price unit probe, not executable wallet
ridge_objective: sum squared normalized residuals + 1*sum squared slopes; intercept unpenalized; scaler fit2021 only, no target/outcome feature
bootstrap: Joint asset+paired arm circular contiguous four-week blocks separately within both2022halves; no IID asset bootstrap; conditional descriptive interval
gates: augmentedpred>0 in at least20 distinct marketweeks
selection: Zero threshold fixed exante; cash whenever prediction<=0; no imposed short share, selected months, fee/holding/lambda grids or inverted failed factor
secondary_proxy: Initial .12 reference notional per eligible predicted-positive asset; every weekly probe pays independent entry+exit; all calendar weeks retained, missing future eligible price stops. No actual risk/quantity path
future_funding: Training outcome description only, both raw-as-fraction and raw-as-percent sums retained; never input or actual cash; no future charge-mark imputation
development_gate: Any gate fails => STOP without returning any 2023/2024 development values. All pass => only then consider separately frozen development phase; no automatic wallet
retries_search: No implicit real-run retry, no HPO/continuation; setup failures preserved
preserve: CPD STOP and all old science
public_persistence: Explicit user authorization: source/protocol/small evidence/necessary models public on independent research branch, remoteSHA and actual readback
